**[P2] Cache the tokenless response for idempotent retries**

`CheckpointCore.apply()` caches its generated token before this line hides it. A retry using the same `ClientToken` therefore returns the cached non-null token from `_maybe_replay_cached()`, allowing the paused invocation to continue checkpointing. The same mismatch exists in `checkpoint/processor.py`. Persist whether the externally returned token was withheld (including across resume) and replay `None`; add retry coverage for both checkpoint paths.
